COMPLETE is legal only from actual supplied evidence or actually delivered facts. Metadata alone is NEVER source facts. Supply a bounded substantive answer satisfying the user's actual request, never merely repeat its referent phrase. Each fact claim cites an exact quote from actually supplied evidence, its current revision and inclusive one-based source provenance. The displayed text may paraphrase fact claims. The quote must be copied exactly (including punctuation) from a supplied evidence.text. Include at least one fact per target and only currently delivered explanation lines. If missing detail, READ necessary bounded ranges. A later fact may need an original read even if recent answers concern that source. Do not invent IDs or values. Preserve unknowns and correction scope.
